author: Brokennz
body:
Hello! we may present to you Valley of Wood, a new map created by AbusiveUser (me) & iScaglia!
The map was hosted and created in Cloudy! thanks to ShinyDialga for hosting it.

We tried to create a map where you can make many strategies as you want! and also, we think the layout of the map is good to have a good match (:

Creators: AbusiveUser & iScaglia
Server hosted by: ShinyDialga
Gamemode: 5CP (Atlas Update)
It features 5 points in total to capture, with spawns getting closer to the enemy team as you capture the points.
Recommended Size: 8v8 for a Tournament
Building time: 1 day
Feedback: Tomqss and Claf

Links:
  • Full Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/DXmhZ
  • Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?es28g43h7527hhm
  • XML: We need help with this, if someone can make it hit me!
----- Version 1.0.2 -----       
  • Imgur Album [NEW]: http://imgur.com/a/d1T20
  • Download (1.9 needed): https://www.mediafire.com/?14qb914z3wry8jd
----- ----- ----- -----  ----- 
Well, that's all for today, remember that the feedback is always appreciated and it will help to improve in our future maps.
Thanks, ~Abusive!

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
See the issue with maps designed for 5CP is that unless you've seen handfulls of other successful maps of this gamemode, you can easily make the mistake of assuming capturing a point is rather easy, well it's not if the map is closed in and players are given only limited pathways.
My point is that corridors in a 5CP map are bad for gameplay. Most 5CP maps are large open maps with endless terrain entrances, pathways and exits.
The map present is still looking great in aesthetics and is built very creatively. Just try to fix up the gameplay issues. Then hopefully you'll be good to go!

replies.author: Brokennz
replies.body:
@Speeded - Nope, it's two things very different.

The point of the KotH is that you need to reach certain points to win, for example, you need to reach 750 points to win (the map only have one point to capture)

While the point of the 5CP, is that you need to capture the 5 points after the time is out, 
you will respawn more closer for every point captured (also if the opposite team capture more points than you, your team will respawn more fartest).

Sorry, but my english is not perfect ):
